newsitem.title: USA: Fitch to add bond analyst in Chicago in September.
newsitem.headline: Fitch to add bond analyst in Chicago in September.

text.p: Fitch Investors Service Inc announced Friday it has hired Joseph O'Keefe from Standard & Poor's Corp to add analytical services for debt issuers and investors to its midwest regional office in Chicago this September.
O'Keefe will serve as senior director for the new service, handling major tax-backed credits in the midwest and business development efforts, midwest region Managing Director Michael Belsky said.
Fitch expanded its San Francisco office in March to allow bond issuers to meet with analysts and interact with rating committees as well.
